facts.text: Under the Saluki Commitment, SIU pledges to cover whatever tuition and mandatory fees are not covered by a qualifying new or transfer student's financial aid package.

sources.title: Saluki | SIU Carbondale
sources.quote: The Saluki Commitment. Our pledge to qualifying new and transfer students to cover whatever tuition and mandatory fees your financial aid package does not.

facts.text: SIU has eliminated out-of-state tuition rates for undergraduate students regardless of which state they call home.

sources.title: Saluki | SIU Carbondale
sources.quote: We've Eliminated Out-Of-State Tuition for Undergraduates! We've made it easy to become a Saluki no matter what state you call home.
